review.proposal: Cannot issue a PASS/REJECT audit from a plan description alone. To unblock, supply: (1) a read-only snapshot or hash manifest of the exact per-symbol OHLC datasets used (crypto H1 OKX-first, with every fallback event logged: symbol, timestamp range, source used, reason); (2) the actual per-symbol geometry-search code/config showing the search is run independently per symbol with no cross-symbol pooling of stats or thresholds; (3) explicit train/validation date boundaries per symbol with an embargo gap to rule out lookahead/leakage, plus confirmation no eligible trading day was silently dropped (row-count reconciliation before/after filtering); (4) a diff or provenance log showing early-August-onward 'FINAL' data and parameters were never touched by V64/V69/V73-derived values; (5) a deterministic replay harness (fixed seed, fixed data snapshot) producing win-rate/RR/expectancy metrics reproducibly, to be run only in DEV/VALIDATION, never against FINAL. Once these artifacts are provided, a proper independent audit (data integrity + methodology soundness) can be completed and a PASS/REJECT verdict issued.

Advance candidates only if each symbol independently satisfies RR in {1,2}, win rate >=80%, and positive net expectancy on VALIDATION; do not pool metrics or delete failing symbols.
